card.name: Just before a drug name in interaction text
card.fires_on: Commas, small linking words (of, taking, starting) and the first letter of a drug name, in drug-interaction text. The next word is expected to be a drug name such as atorvastatin, eribulin, fenofibrate or simeprevir.

modes.description: A comma between example drugs in a list of substrates.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug
modes.description: Words like of, taking or starting that lead into a named drug.
modes.example: Effects<< of>> eribulin mesylate injection on

modes.label: Start of a split drug name
modes.description: The lone letter s at the start of simeprevir.
modes.example: lopinavir plus ritonavir, or<< s>>imeprevir, consider the risk/b
